request.style: English, cinematic orchestral hymn, soaring female soprano lead with mixed choir, strings, French horns, timpani, harp, celesta, awe-filled and spacious, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Chorus]
LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth
You have set your splendor above the heavens
LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth

[Verse]
From the mouths of children and infants
You have established strength because of your foes
To silence the enemy and the avenger

[Verse]
When I look at your heavens, the work of your fingers
The moon and the stars that you set in place
What is a human being that you remember him
A son of man that you care for him

[Chorus]
LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth
You have set your splendor above the heavens
LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth

[Bridge]
You made him a little lower than God
And crowned him with glory and honor
You gave him dominion over the works of your hands
You put everything under his feet
All the flocks and herds, and the beasts of the field as well
The birds of the sky and the fish of the sea
Whatever passes along the paths of the seas

[Outro]
LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth
